## 4. Peak Masterpiece Implementation

### 4.1 New Module: `src/experience_memory.rs`

```rust
// src/experience_memory.rs - MemGovern Integration Module
//
// Peak Masterpiece: Sovereign Experience Memory System
// Integrates MemGovern patterns with House of Wisdom HyperGraphRAG

use crate::wisdom::{HouseOfWisdom, KnowledgeNode, HybridSearchResult};
use crate::receipts::{Receipt, ReceiptType};
use crate::sat::SATOrchestrator;
use crate::fate::constraint_smt::FateEngine;
use crate::ihsan::IhsanScorer;
use crate::fixed::Fixed64;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Experience lifecycle states (Ibn Khaldun model)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum ExperienceLifecycle {
    Nascent,    // < 7 days, single instance
    Emerging,   // 7-30 days, multiple instances
    Mature,     // 30-180 days, validated
    Classic,    // > 180 days, proven durability
    Declining,  // Retrieval rate dropping
    Obsolete,   // Superseded or deprecated
}

/// Experience Card (MemGovern format)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExperienceCard {
    pub problem_summary: String,
    pub signals: Vec<String>,
    pub root_cause: String,
    pub fix_strategy: String,
    pub patch_digest: String,
    pub verification: String,
}

/// Transfer compatibility context
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TransferContext {
    pub language: String,
    pub framework: Option<String>,
    pub dependencies: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub architecture: Option<String>,
}

/// Transformation function (Al-Ghazali's knowledge-action unity)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TransformationFunction {
    pub preconditions: Vec<String>,   // What must be true
    pub operations: Vec<String>,      // Abstract edit operations
    pub postconditions: Vec<String>,  // What becomes true
}

/// Complete Experience Receipt
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExperienceReceipt {
    pub receipt_id: String,
    pub source_repo: String,
    pub source_issue: String,
    pub experience_card: ExperienceCard,
    pub lifecycle: ExperienceLifecycle,
    pub graph_centrality: f64,
    pub transfer_context: TransferContext,
    pub transformation: TransformationFunction,
    pub ihsan_score: Fixed64,
    pub sat_consensus: f64,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub last_retrieval: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub retrieval_count: u32,
    pub success_rate: f64,
}

/// Stage-gated retrieval result
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct RetrievalResult {
    pub experiences: Vec<RankedExperience>,
    pub query_time_ms: u64,
    pub stages_executed: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct RankedExperience {
    pub experience: ExperienceReceipt,
    pub relevance_score: f64,
    pub transfer_score: f64,
    pub temporal_weight: f64,
    pub final_score: f64,
}

/// Sovereign Experience Memory System
pub struct SovereignExperienceMemory {
    wisdom: HouseOfWisdom,
    sat: SATOrchestrator,
    fate: FateEngine,
    ihsan: IhsanScorer,
}

impl SovereignExperienceMemory {
    /// Create from environment
    pub async fn from_env() -> Self {
        Self {
            wisdom: HouseOfWisdom::from_env_with_vectors().await,
            sat: SATOrchestrator::new(),
            fate: FateEngine::new(),
            ihsan: IhsanScorer::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Store experience with SAT validation
    pub async fn store_experience(
        &self,
        card: ExperienceCard,
        source_repo: &str,
        source_issue: &str,
        transfer_ctx: TransferContext,
        transformation: TransformationFunction,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        // 1. Calculate Ihsan score
        let ihsan = self.calculate_experience_ihsan(&card, &transfer_ctx);

        // Quality gate: Ihsan >= 0.85 for experience storage
        if ihsan.to_f64() < 0.85 {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
                "Experience quality below threshold: {} < 0.85",
                ihsan.to_f64()
            ));
        }

        // 2. SAT validation (all 6 must approve)
        let sat_result = self.sat.validate_experience(&card).await?;
        if !sat_result.all_approved() {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
                "SAT validation failed: {:?}",
                sat_result.vetoes()
            ));
        }

        // 3. Create receipt
        let receipt = ExperienceReceipt {
            receipt_id: format!("EXP-{}-{}",
                chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
                uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()[..8].to_string()
            ),
            source_repo: source_repo.to_string(),
            source_issue: source_issue.to_string(),
            experience_card: card,
            lifecycle: ExperienceLifecycle::Nascent,
            graph_centrality: 0.0, // Will be updated by consolidation job
            transfer_context: transfer_ctx,
            transformation,
            ihsan_score: ihsan,
            sat_consensus: sat_result.consensus_score(),
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            last_retrieval: None,
            retrieval_count: 0,
            success_rate: 0.0,
        };

        // 4. Store in dual stores
        // ChromaDB for vector search (episodic)
        let content = format!(
            "{}\n\nSignals: {}\n\nRoot Cause: {}\n\nFix Strategy: {}",
            receipt.experience_card.problem_summary,
            receipt.experience_card.signals.join(", "),
            receipt.experience_card.root_cause,
            receipt.experience_card.fix_strategy
        );

        self.wisdom.store_knowledge_with_embedding(
            "Experience",
            &content,
            serde_json::to_value(&receipt)?,
        ).await?;

        Ok(receipt.receipt_id)
    }

    /// Stage-gated retrieval with SNR optimization
    pub async fn retrieve(
        &self,
        problem: &str,
        current_context: &TransferContext,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<RetrievalResult> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();
        let mut stages = Vec::new();

        // Stage 1: High-recall vector search (200 candidates)
        stages.push("vector_search".to_string());
        let vector_results = self.wisdom.vector_search(problem, 200).await?;

        // Stage 2: Graph-constrained filtering via Neo4j
        stages.push("graph_filter".to_string());
        let graph_results = self.wisdom.query_knowledge(problem, 50).await?;

        // Stage 3: Merge and filter by transfer compatibility
        stages.push("transfer_filter".to_string());
        let mut candidates: Vec<RankedExperience> = Vec::new();

        for vr in vector_results {
            if let Some(exp) = self.parse_experience_from_metadata(&vr.metadata) {
                let transfer_score = self.calculate_transfer_compatibility(
                    &exp.transfer_context,
                    current_context
                );

                // Filter out incompatible transfers
                if transfer_score < 0.3 {
                    continue;
                }

                let temporal_weight = self.calculate_temporal_weight(&exp);
                let relevance = 1.0 - vr.distance; // Convert distance to similarity

                candidates.push(RankedExperience {
                    experience: exp,
                    relevance_score: relevance,
                    transfer_score,
                    temporal_weight,
                    final_score: relevance * transfer_score * temporal_weight,
                });
            }
        }

        // Stage 4: FATE precondition validation
        stages.push("precondition_check".to_string());
        let validated: Vec<_> = candidates.into_iter()
            .filter(|c| self.fate.check_preconditions_simple(&c.experience.transformation.preconditions))
            .collect();

        // Stage 5: SNR reranking
        stages.push("snr_rerank".to_string());
        let mut ranked = validated;
        ranked.sort_by(|a, b| b.final_score.partial_cmp(&a.final_score).unwrap());

        Ok(RetrievalResult {
            experiences: ranked.into_iter().take(limit).collect(),
            query_time_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
            stages_executed: stages,
        })
    }

    /// Calculate Ihsan score for experience
    fn calculate_experience_ihsan(
        &self,
        card: &ExperienceCard,
        _ctx: &TransferContext,
    ) -> Fixed64 {
        let mut score = 0.0;

        // Completeness (all 6 fields populated)
        let fields = [
            !card.problem_summary.is_empty(),
            !card.signals.is_empty(),
            !card.root_cause.is_empty(),
            !card.fix_strategy.is_empty(),
            !card.patch_digest.is_empty(),
            !card.verification.is_empty(),
        ];
        let completeness = fields.iter().filter(|&&f| f).count() as f64 / 6.0;
        score += completeness * 0.3;

        // Signal quality (10-18 keywords is optimal)
        let signal_count = card.signals.len();
        let signal_quality = if signal_count >= 10 && signal_count <= 18 {
            1.0
        } else if signal_count >= 5 {
            0.8
        } else {
            0.5
        };
        score += signal_quality * 0.2;

        // Generalizability (no repo-specific paths)
        let has_specific_paths = card.problem_summary.contains("/home/")
            || card.problem_summary.contains("C:\\")
            || card.fix_strategy.contains(".git");
        let generalizability = if has_specific_paths { 0.5 } else { 1.0 };
        score += generalizability * 0.3;

        // Verification quality
        let has_test_plan = card.verification.contains("test")
            || card.verification.contains("verify")
            || card.verification.contains("check");
        let verification_quality = if has_test_plan { 1.0 } else { 0.6 };
        score += verification_quality * 0.2;

        Fixed64::from_f64(score)
    }

    /// Calculate transfer compatibility (0.0 - 1.0)
    fn calculate_transfer_compatibility(
        &self,
        source: &TransferContext,
        target: &TransferContext,
    ) -> f64 {
        let mut score = 1.0;

        // Hard requirement: language must match
        if source.language != target.language {
            return 0.0;
        }

        // Framework matching
        match (&source.framework, &target.framework) {
            (Some(s), Some(t)) if s != t => score *= 0.6,
            (Some(_), None) | (None, Some(_)) => score *= 0.8,
            _ => {}
        }

        // Dependency version compatibility
        for (dep, version) in &source.dependencies {
            if let Some(target_version) = target.dependencies.get(dep) {
                // Simple major version check
                let src_major = version.split('.').next().unwrap_or("0");
                let tgt_major = target_version.split('.').next().unwrap_or("0");
                if src_major != tgt_major {
                    score *= 0.7;
                }
            }
        }

        // Architecture compatibility
        match (&source.architecture, &target.architecture) {
            (Some(s), Some(t)) if s != t => score *= 0.5,
            _ => {}
        }

        score
    }

    /// Calculate temporal weight (Ibn Khaldun lifecycle)
    fn calculate_temporal_weight(&self, exp: &ExperienceReceipt) -> f64 {
        let now = chrono::Utc::now();
        let age_days = (now - exp.created_at).num_days();

        // Base decay
        let base_weight = match age_days {
            0..=30 => 1.0,
            31..=180 => 0.95,
            181..=365 => 0.85,
            366..=730 => 0.70,
            _ => 0.50,
        };

        // Recency boost from successful retrieval
        let recency_boost = if let Some(last) = exp.last_retrieval {
            let days_since = (now - last).num_days();
            match days_since {
                0..=7 => 0.2,
                8..=30 => 0.1,
                _ => 0.0,
            }
        } else {
            0.0
        };

        // Success rate multiplier
        let success_mult = 0.5 + (exp.success_rate * 0.5);

        // Network centrality bonus (asabiyyah)
        let centrality_bonus = exp.graph_centrality * 0.15;

        (base_weight + recency_boost + centrality_bonus) * success_mult
    }

    fn parse_experience_from_metadata(&self, _metadata: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<ExperienceReceipt> {
        // Implementation would deserialize from stored metadata
        None // Placeholder
    }
}
```
